note: The USB-C block's ESD part (rules/blocks/usbc.json). The DCK package: IO1 is pin 1, IO2 pin 2, GND pin 3 (section 5, Pin Functions, page 3), as the KiCad symbol TPD2E2U06DCK numbers them. Each IO clamps to GND (section 7.2, Functional Block Diagram, page 8). VRWM is 5.5 V at most with IIO under 10 uA (section 6.5, page 4); VIO runs 0 to 5.5 V (section 6.3, page 4). The line capacitance, 1.5 pF typical and 1.9 pF at most (section 6.5, page 4), is not a key of the facts and is not judged
